name: DEVOID
source:
When a human moves into a new apartment, they decide to explore the area to meet their new neighbours. But they must be careful as the building is not all as it seems.

[From [url=https://anizyart.itch.io/devoid]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名人类搬进新公寓后，决定探索周围环境，认识一下新邻居。不过，探索时必须小心，因为这栋楼并非表面上看起来那么简单。

[摘自[url=https://anizyart.itch.io/devoid]Itch.io[/url]]
